summary: Runway 07 instrument landing system at EGVN restricted to localiser and distance measuring equipment only, and unmonitored.
text:
RWY 07 ILS RESTRICTED TO LOC/DME ONLY AND UNMONITORED.
RWY 07 LOC NOT TO BE USED MORE THAN 20 DEG SOUTH OF EXTENDED 
CENTRELINE DUE TO FALSE CAPTURE RISK. LOC FLAGS MAY OCCUR 
17-25NM FROM LOC BELOW 2500FT WHEN MORE THAN 5 DEG EITHER SIDE
OF CENTRELINE. LOC AND DME IDENT NOT SYNCHRONISED. RWY 25: GP
FLAGS MAY OCCUR WHEN CLOSING FROM MORE THAN 8 DEG LEFT OF 
CENTRELINE. AUTO COUPLED APPROACHES PERMITTED TO CAT I DH, GP 
FLUCTUATIONS MAY OCCUR. FALSE DME RANGES MAY OCCUR 17-25NM LEFT 
OF CENTRELINE.
TACAN BZN/BRIZE NORTON 111.900 CH56X. AIRCREW MAY EXPERIENCE UNLOCKS 
AROUND RADIAL 250 DEG.
